name: planning-pack
description: Two planning skills for daily-driver Claude models: planning (turn a goal plus the system's real state into an executable work contract before building) and plan-reconciliation (revise or close an executing plan when reality diverges). Planning defines the contract; execution is governed by the Ops Pack (operational-rigor and its siblings), which this pack names. Installable separately; designed to run alongside `ops-pack` (not bundled with it). Few dense rules, executable gates over long prose. Registers no hooks.
